policy.alignment: Source MIDI notes and complete source harmony retain exact quarter-beat onsets/durations. No padding, truncation or time shifts. Every source row/measure is visual geometry only.
policy.arrangements: Different source changes/forms remain separate arrangements of the original composition.
policy.measureMap: Matching initial compiler PartialSet when present, plus authored TimeSignatureMusic changes and contiguous source boundaries. Quarter-beat note/harmony clocks remain unchanged; standard MIDI retains actual source time-signature events.
policy.form: Explicit source-measure arrangements retain authored row geometry rather than inheriting unaudited uniform-bar form alignment.
policy.rights: Each source composition retains its original rights notice and pinned source URL. Repository license alone is not composition permission.
